acceptance: Each of the four benchmarks has SF 100 evidence or an owner-approved narrowing recorded here.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
generator-validation-large-scales-20261111 was closed as 'retained as deferred' although SSB and the primitives benchmarks at SF 100 were never run and no successor or deferral existed.

## Change
Run generation-only validation for SSB, read_primitives, write_primitives and transaction_primitives at SF 100 through `make heavy-run`, or get the owner's decision to narrow the scope.

## Decision gates
Disk and time: estimate output size first; if any run needs more than the host's free disk or a quiet window, ask the owner before starting. The owner earlier limited SF 100 runs to TPC-DI (2026-11-17), so running these needs the owner's go-ahead.

## Verification rubric
Pass: per benchmark, generated bytes, row counts, wall time and peak memory are recorded with the command and the heavy-run log path; or an owner narrowing is recorded.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
